instruction: Insert both batteries and try their orientations until the instrument works. Use observation feedback to avoid repeating failed combinations.

perception.query: blue battery. black gauge. robot arm. battery holder.

visual_criteria.seated:left: The battery on world-left appears fully seated in its battery slot.
visual_criteria.seated:right: The battery on world-right appears fully seated in its battery slot.
visual_criteria.dashboard:on: The instrument needle visibly indicates activation, distinct from its off/resting position.
visual_criteria.visual:complete: Both batteries appear fully seated and the instrument needle visibly indicates activation.

perception.assessment_prompt: Judge only current RGB, mask overlay and the initial RGB reference. Return each criterion once with visible evidence. Detections do not prove insertion. Compare the visible instrument needle to its initial resting position; do not assume a particular needle angle. If the needle or seating cannot be resolved, return unknown with low confidence. Do not infer hidden electrical polarity or assume execution succeeded. Return independent target_assignments for the visible individual blue batteries, using left/right world-x roles. Each assignment must identify a current detection, confidence, and visible evidence. One reliable target is useful even when the other is occluded. Leave uncertain roles unassigned; never reconstruct a hidden object from an old position. Exclude battery holders, gauges, robot parts and a box enclosing both batteries together. Omit any ambiguous assignment. The object_details image magnifies each detected box: current image on the left, initial reference at the same pixel region on the right; it is not new sensor resolution.
